answer: Like a seabed secreting nacre layer by layer, decentralized consensus crystallizes identity through time: an agent must polish its reputation like an iridescent pearl inside an iterative proof-of-interaction mesh. Much like seasoning sturdy timber or cracking open a stubborn walnut to extract concentrated nourishment, true identity requires slow metabolic commitment. Sybil attackers face a superlinear minting cost: forging multiple faux nodes incurs an exponential stake-locking function, rendering mass duplication economically ruinous.
